A smart assistant that gets phone tasks done
Enable the following permissions so the app can reliably perform phone tasks

This is the core permission for controlling the device.
1. Go to System Settings → Accessibility → Downloaded apps 2. Find "Octopus Mobile" in the list 3. Turn on the switch 4. Confirm in the system dialog
Keeps the app running stably in the background and reduces the chance of being stopped by the system.\n\nTap this item to enable. Android 13+ will request notification permission first.

Shows a floating panel to view task execution status.
1. Go to System Settings → Apps → Octopus Mobile 2. Find "Display over other apps" 3. Turn on the switch
Prevents the system from stopping the app in the background.\n\nTap this item and confirm "Allow" in the system dialog. Some devices need to be set to "Unrestricted".

Allows reading and writing device files.

Android 11+: Go to System Settings and enable "All files access".
Android 10 and below: Grant permission in the popup.
Handle protected popups and capture secure windows

By default, the Android Accessibility API is used, which is enough for most app operations. A few capabilities require Shizuku:
• Tapping permission/system popups (FLAG_SECURE) • Capturing DRM-protected screens • Force-stopping apps, modifying system settings
Shizuku is a safe, open-source local helper tool.

Setup steps:
1. Install Shizuku from Play Store or GitHub
2. Start it once via Wireless Debugging (Android 11+) or PC ADB
3. Return here, Octopus will detect it automatically
